whatIs: Tailkits is a directory of products for developers: templates, components, boilerplates and tools for design, AI, email, analytics and CMS. It currently shows about 300 products, with editorial review of every submission.

It has a search box (⌘K), sorting by newest or name and a price filter: each card says whether the product is free, paid or freemium. It's a good fit for discovering Tailwind and React templates and components.
uses: Looking for a landing page template for Next.js or Astro.
Filtering for free products only for a project with no budget.
Finding individual sections, such as heroes or pricing tables, to reuse.
caveats: There are sponsored cards, marked as such, that appear above the list.
Each product has its own price and license: check them on its page.
pricingNote: Browsing is free; makers pay to list and sponsor their products.
idealFor: People looking for Tailwind or React templates and components, both free and paid.
